description: Search menu items of Japanese restaurant chains and stores, and packaged foods of Japanese food makers, and get their nutrition facts. Queries that return no results are counted anonymously (the query text and chain only) to decide which chains to add. query matches item name, size, category, genre and chain name (Japanese; spaces mean AND; katakana/hiragana and full/half width are treated alike; common chain nicknames like ケンタ, マック, サイゼ work). Combine with chain / genre / kcal range. Use nutrient to find items rich in a nutrient (only chains that publish it). Default order: with nutrient, by that nutrient descending; else with a query, by how well the item name matches ("relevance"); otherwise by kcal ascending. total includes discontinued items (listed last), so it can be larger than item_count in list_chains. Each item has an id for sum_items, a page url, and the chain's source_file.

chain.description: Chain id from list_chains, or its Japanese name / nickname.

nutrient.description: Only items that publish this nutrient. net_carb_g is net carbohydrate (carbohydrate minus fiber, 糖質); sugar_g is sugars (糖類) — different quantities. Keys: kcal=エネルギー(kcal), protein_g=たんぱく質(g), fat_g=脂質(g), saturated_g=飽和脂肪酸(g), carb_g=炭水化物(g), net_carb_g=糖質(g), sugar_g=糖類(g), fiber_g=食物繊維(g), salt_g=食塩相当量(g), sodium_mg=ナトリウム(mg), potassium_mg=カリウム(mg), calcium_mg=カルシウム(mg), phosphorus_mg=リン(mg), iron_mg=鉄(mg), vit_a_ug=ビタミンA(μg), retinol_ug=レチノール(μg), carotene_ug=β-カロテン当量(μg), vit_b1_mg=ビタミンB1(mg), vit_b2_mg=ビタミンB2(mg), niacin_mg=ナイアシン(mg), vit_c_mg=ビタミンC(mg), vit_d_ug=ビタミンD(μg), vit_e_mg=ビタミンE(mg), cholesterol_mg=コレステロール(mg), ash_g=灰分(g), weight_g=重量(g)

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "牛丼 並盛", "チーズバーガー", "すき家 カレー".

sort.description: Default: nutrient_desc when nutrient is given, else relevance when query is given, else kcal_asc.

name: search_menu
title: Search menu items
